SCOPE AND LIMITS
The seven negative controls above are evidence packages, not seven A1-A10 attack cases.
The attack harness includes expected demonstrations of disclosed limitations; HELD does not mean every attempted attack is prevented.
Freshness is relative to the pinned witness log. Signature validity does not independently establish real-world identity or key custody.
No new full 27-guard mutation experiment, full A/B or V15 harness run, Go-port execution, corruption sweep, corridor simulation, execution-boundary probe, live deployment, or hardware test was performed in this follow-up. Earlier results for those experiments remain attached to the earlier commit; unchanged code does not constitute a fresh execution.
The prior 12-page strategic PDF remains a historical record of the earlier baseline; this bundle supplies the new verification record. Nothing was sent to Chad or published to GitHub.

REPRODUCTION
Exact commands, exits and timings: commands.json.
SHA-256 source/fixture hashes and platform: provenance.json.
Logs are included for every check. run_checks.py is the orchestration script used; its absolute paths are local to this review environment. It runs independent checks concurrently, with PYTHONPATH set to the reviewed worktree. The targeted mutation changes tools/verify_package.py inside a temporary copy, as implemented by the author tool.
